targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^org\.openegiz\.sarybulak:truck-/ and (r._field == "value_state_properties_value" or r._field == "value_payload_properties_value" or r._field == "value_speed_properties_value" or r._field == "value_fuel_properties_value" or r._field == "value_fuel_rate_properties_value" or r._field == "value_trips_total_properties_value" or r._field == "value_hours_properties_value" or r._field == "value_health_pct_properties_value" or r._field == "value_destination_properties_value" or r._field == "value_assigned_excavator_properties_value"))
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["thingId"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_measurement", "parent", "originator", "correlationId", "topic", "host"])

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^org\.openegiz\.sarybulak:truck-/ and r._field == "value_speed_properties_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, twin: r.thingId}))
  |> group(columns: ["twin"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
